headline: Hezbollah command hub destroyed, Houthis seize Bab al-Mandab, and Russia targets Kyiv gas stations
subheadline: IDF eliminated Hezbollah’s 2‑km underground command network in Ali Taher ridge, while Houthis captured Perim Island and Dubab, shutting Saudi oil pipeline
lede: IDF destroyed Hezbollah’s 2‑kilometer underground command network in the Ali Taher ridge, eliminating dozens of rockets, missiles, UAVs, and anti‑tank weapons. Houthis captured Perim Island and Dubab, securing the Bab al‑Mandab strait and forcing the shutdown of Saudi Arabia’s East‑West oil pipeline after attacks in Riyadh and Medina. Yemeni forces expelled Saudi‑backed troops from six districts in Ta’iz and Hudaydah, burning dozens of vehicles, while IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas commander Muhammad Yazouri in Khan Younis and IRGC launched a cruise missile toward the Strait of Hormuz.

sections.title: Kyiv Gas Station Drone Strikes, Budget Crisis
sections.body: Russia employed jet‑powered drones for the first time to strike three Ukrnafta gas stations in Kyiv over two days, marking a new phase of aerial attacks on the capital. Ukraine faces a €26 billion defense budget shortfall after exhausting most of its 2026 allocation, leaving critical shortages of Patriot missiles and troops as winter approaches. In the Donetsk region, two National Guard soldiers captured near Dobropillya were executed by Russian forces with automatic weapons on September 2, while an airstrike destroyed a railway bridge in Slaviansk linking the city center to eastern suburbs. Zelensky reported strikes on oil facilities across multiple Russian regions and the Black Sea, and Russian forces destroyed a logistics hub in Gostomel storing components for long‑ and medium‑range drone production.

sections.title: Hezbollah Hub Destroyed, Houthis Seize Strait
sections.body: IDF eliminated Hezbollah’s central underground command and control infrastructure in the Ali Taher ridge, a 2‑km network containing dozens of rockets, missiles, UAVs, and anti‑tank weapons. Houthis seized Perim Island and the coastal town of Dubab, completing their takeover of the strategic Bab al‑Mandab strait and forcing the shutdown of Saudi Arabia’s East‑West oil pipeline after attacks in Riyadh and Medina. Yemeni armed forces expelled Saudi‑backed troops from six districts in Ta’iz and Hudaydah provinces, burning dozens of vehicles, while IDF and Shin Bet killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Yazouri and two other militants in a precise airstrike. IRGC launched a cruise missile from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz, escalating maritime threats and underscoring Iran’s direct involvement in the regional pressure campaign.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous degradation of Hezbollah’s command network and Houthi control of the Bab al‑Mandab strait, coupled with Iran’s cruise missile launch, signals a coordinated multi‑axis escalation targeting global energy and maritime routes. In Ukraine, Russia’s first use of jet drones against Kyiv’s gas stations combined with a €26 billion budget shortfall and dwindling Patriot stocks creates a compounding threat to defensive sustainability as winter looms.
